$comment: IC workspace (dogfood): block cross-repo edits/commits to the toolkit PRIMARY checkout. This workspace stays writable on master; only the linked toolkit checkout is guarded. Commands are wrapped so a MULTI-ROOT Cursor session cannot deadlock: ${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR} resolves to ONE root, which may be a repo with no .cursor/hooks/ of its own — unwrapped, /bin/sh exits 127 (script not found) and failClosed turns that into a policy DENY, blocking every edit and shell call across the whole session. The wrapper never fails open: the MARKER directory .cursor/hooks decides. Marker ABSENT means this root is not guard-configured and the hook does not apply (exit 0); marker PRESENT but the script missing means a configured workspace whose guard was deleted or broken, which is exit 3 (could-not-evaluate, mapped to a block) so guard-toolkit-primary.sh and its tripwire can never be bypassed by removing a file. The check is inline because a helper script would sit at the same unresolvable path.

beforeShellExecution.command: /bin/sh -c 'm="$1"; p="$2"; shift 2; [ -f "$p" ] && exec /bin/sh "$p" "$@"; [ -d "$m" ] && { echo "AIOS hook: guard-configured workspace is missing $p" >&2; exit 3; }; exit 0' _ "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.cursor/hooks" "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.cursor/hooks/guard-toolkit-primary.sh" pre_command

preToolUse.command: /bin/sh -c 'm="$1"; p="$2"; shift 2; [ -f "$p" ] && exec /bin/sh "$p" "$@"; [ -d "$m" ] && { echo "AIOS hook: guard-configured workspace is missing $p" >&2; exit 3; }; exit 0' _ "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.cursor/hooks" "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.cursor/hooks/guard-toolkit-primary.sh" pre_edit

stop.command: /bin/sh -c 'm="$1"; p="$2"; shift 2; [ -f "$p" ] && exec /bin/sh "$p" "$@"; [ -d "$m" ] && { echo "AIOS hook: guard-configured workspace is missing $p" >&2; exit 3; }; exit 0' _ "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.cursor/hooks" "${CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR}/.cursor/hooks/toolkit-primary-tripwire.sh"
